-- an unaccepted cancellation, including direct administrative SQL transitions.

 operator_version INTEGER NOT NULL
);

 WHEN OLD.status='invited' AND NEW.status='inactive'

 WHEN NEW.status='active' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM oa_invitation_cancellations WHERE operator_id=OLD.id)
 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'invitation_required'); END;

);

 JOIN vector_http_bootstrap b ON b.id=1
 JOIN vector_http_bootstrap_current c ON c.snapshot=b.snapshot
 JOIN vector_auth_operators m ON m.operator_id=r.actor_id AND m.auth_id=r.auth_id

 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM oa_dev_credentials)
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM oa_invitation_cancellations)
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM operator_sessions)
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM magic_links)

-- This excluded-table trigger survives Base's included-table trigger suppression.

WHEN NEW.namespace LIKE 'vector-import:%' AND NEW.checkpoint>OLD.checkpoint
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM vector_import_runs r WHERE r.job_id=NEW.id
  AND (NEW.checkpoint-OLD.checkpoint=r.batch_size OR (NEW.checkpoint=NEW.total AND NEW.checkpoint-OLD.checkpoint<r.batch_size)))
